title: Battle of Urmia (1604)
text: The Battle of Urmia, also Urumiyeh, was fought near Lake Urmia in north-western Iran between the Safavid and Ottoman empires and resulted in a decisive Safavid victory. The Ottomans were fooled into an ambush by the Iranian army where many of them were killed or captured in an encirclement manoeuvre. Over the next three years all of western and northern Iran were recaptured and the Safavids even re-established their suzerainty over their former vassals in the Caucasus.
